reviews.title: It’s okay
reviews.text: Works pretty good most of the time; however, I’m going to cancel. I had the unlimited plan and today it quit analyzing food because it said my “Open AI” limit was reached. Also it consistently analyzed foods well above the actual calories. My buddy had the Android version and his were usually 200 cals lower. Devs need to update this app.

reviews.title: Stopped Working Randomly
reviews.text: I got the app and even payed for a yearly subscription and then all of a sudden the scan camera stopped working. My phone’s regular camera works fine, but the app scanning feature just stopped working entirely. Right after I payed the 30$ for the subscription too. I tried redownloading the app but nothing worked. Nice.

reviews.title: Overall good app but has glitches
reviews.text: It gets the job done, easy to use. But it does have some flaws. After 31 days, the app stops updating the streak of how many days straight you’ve been logging. It also doesn’t allow you to go back to previous logs other than the ones for the week you’re on (Mon-Sunday). I find those two things pretty annoying as sometimes I have to research the macros for a food item and it would be nice to be able to view it from previous weeks if I eat it again vs having to go search for it online again. And not being able to see the accurate streak days is a bit discouraging.

reviews.text: I used MyFitnessPal for years and this is 10000x easier and I’m more inclined to log food because of that. My only complaint is that there aren’t any home screen widgets available!

reviews.title: Best app
reviews.text: Very easy and simple, designed very well.

reviews.title: Features
reviews.text: So far, I’m enjoying the app, but some things that could be helpful would be to be able to see the specific grams that I added to each item if I need to reuse it again. Can we make it so that we can go back to previous weeks to see what food we did eat right now it just stays on the current week (M-Sun). We only have the option to change the serving size by 1/2. Would like the option to put in specific grams or and to change it by 1/4th.
